acceptanceCriteria: A revision-pinned page-object model lists each class with its methods, parameters, locators (kind + strength) and the ordered actions each method performs, with source spans, for Playwright/Cypress TS and at least one Ruby form (Capybara/SitePrism); other forms abstain naming the file.
Page objects join to appmap screens; methods whose effect (navigation, form submit) is statically known record it; unknown effects stay unknown.
Exposed through CLI and MCP with bounded output; fixtures plus one real-adopter sample.
Inherited and helper page-object methods are followed (today TestFile Methods bind by manifest only; V1-1236 is reused or completed, not duplicated).
body: Owner goal (2026-10-19): from an app's existing tests, learn every page object, link/navigation, data setup and the step sequences that do anything in the site; then 'show me how to do X' builds an e2e test that demonstrates X, proven by a live run, or abstains naming what is missing. Inventory at origin/main 6ceee260b: appmap screens/page-object bindings (AMAP-V0), navigation ledger (ANL-V0), flows (AFU-V1), legacy discovery/crosswalk (DCP-V1-060..069), test-knowledge (DCP-V1-086..092, PR #1165), AMSP draft planner, CCE compile/prove (partly unbuilt), NEA/RVN/PWP/TSA validation pieces exist but are not chained. Today page objects are only bound to screens (AMAP-V0-005/013); methods are 'unverified' and their semantics (params, fills, clicks, navigations) are not extracted.
title: Site knowledge 1: extract page objects (class -> methods -> locators -> actions) from Playwright/Cypress TS, Capybara/SitePrism and Selenium tests
